newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rice exports seen improving in May, June.
newsitem.headline: Thai rice exports seen improving in May, June.

text.p: Thai rice exports are expected to reach 400,000-450,000 tonnes a month between May and June on anticipated rising demand from Africa, Iran and Iraq, a senior commerce ministry official said on Friday.
The export trend had improved since April when Thailand sold around 420,000 tonnes of rice, up from 374,000 tonnes exported in March, the official told Reuters.

But rice exports so far this year were still below last year's. Thailand's rice exports between January 1-April 29 were 1.44 million tonnes, against 1.88 million tonnes in the corresponding period in 1996.
"From May onwards, many countries will hold rice auctions under an agreement with the World Trade Organization. This will offer a good opportunity for Thai rice as well," he said.
Iran has bought more than 100,000 tonnes of rice from Thai exporters and was still seeking for more, the official said.
Thailand put 1997 rice export target at 5.5 million tonnes.
